QuestInfo.name: [Eluna Express] Black Wings in Distress
QuestInfo.0: Surana thinks it is important to listen to the Black Wings's story before you make a decision about them. Speak with the Black Wing member.
QuestInfo.1: It seems the Black Wing member mistook you for a fellow member of the organization. According to him, their authority no longer functions as it did in the past. Defeat the monsters inside the mine and return to speak with him more.
QuestInfo.2: You received the Black Wings Hat, the symbol of the Black Wings. You may not have done what Eremos asked, but seeing that member lament his misfortune was heartbreaking. You defeated plenty of robots, and Surana agrees that it's time to wrap things up here.
